ladderReference.rule: A price response may only reference a frozen ladder construct and a known point index from that file. The ladder is a hypothesis; it is never an offer.

unknownHandling: An unknown amount, currency or VAT treatment is recorded as null/UNKNOWN. It is never coerced to zero and never converted to another currency inside the raw record.
prohibitions: No conversion rate may be derived from stated intent.
No elasticity, revenue or margin may be computed from these responses.
No price may be approved from these responses.
No ladder point may be re-ordered or adjusted after observing a response.
